release.notes: New car image editor (long-press the car on Drive, or Settings > Vehicle; new, please check) with redrawn status overlays; collapsible settings; one CAN/OBD recording page; fault codes in reports summarised as DTCs requiring attention; Ignition shows - instead of a false OFF on classic Hyundai and Kia cars; Android Auto battery cell and module lists (new, please check); new or better readings for Hyundai/Kia, Nissan Leaf/Ariya, Renault Scenic, BYD, VW e-Golf/e-Up, PSA, Tesla Model 3 SR+; BMW i4 and Audi e-tron additions (new, untested).
